claims.claim: We use it to store water in our house and different places
claims.evidence: Witness only reports seeing water storage tanks; no proof of how the seller used them.
Witness says printed markings/labels exist but exact brand/model/grade text is not clearly readable.

claims.claim: Used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: No prior contents/age/usage history is verifiable from the provided observations.
Witness notes condition details like cracks/leaks are not clearly inspectable from the photo angle.
Witness mentions lids on the black tank, but IBC lid/cap completeness is not clearly confirmed for the IBC tanks.

risks.risk: Grade/contamination risk (food-grade vs chemical-grade; prior contents not verifiable).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the IBC label/markings showing grade (e.g., food grade) and any prior-use/handling markings, plus any stamped/printed certification text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-verified/unknown-grade IBC tanks (worst case: treated as not guaranteed food-grade).

risks.risk: Leak/crack risk (micro-cracks, seam leaks, warped fittings not visible from this angle).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the tank filled with water (or a pressure/leak test) and a close-up of seams/valves/tap area with no dripping.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing inspection/testing (worst case: assume may leak; discount accordingly).

risks.risk: Capacity/dimensions mismatch (price depends heavily on liters/size; not readable).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the capacity rating label (liters) or a tape-measure shot of height/width, plus the model number if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest likely size among what’s shown (worst case: smaller capacity).

risks.risk: Valve/tap/spigot condition (taps/hoses only partially visible; could be missing, loose, or damaged).
risks.proof: Close-up photos and a short clip operating the tap (open/close) showing smooth function and no seepage at the valve connection.
risks.if_unproven: Price as without guaranteed working tap/attachments (worst case: treat as needing replacement parts).

risks.risk: Cage integrity (metal cage could be bent/weak; affects safety and transport).
risks.proof: Photos showing the full metal cage from multiple angles, especially corners and base, with straight alignment visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cage condition unknown (worst case: assume cage may be bent/damaged).

risks.risk: Lid/cap completeness and sealing (could be missing or not sealing properly).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the top openings/lids/caps for each IBC tank, showing they are present and seated correctly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing/uncertain sealing (worst case: assume lids/caps may need replacement).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the IBC label/markings showing grade (food/chemical) and any certification text.
Photo of the capacity rating (liters) and/or model number; include a tape-measure shot if label is unreadable.
Video showing the tap/valve area: open/close operation and no seepage at the connection.
Video or photos of a leak test (fill with water and show seams/valve/tap for dripping).
Full photos of the metal cage from all sides to confirm it is straight and intact.
Close-up photos of the top lids/caps for each tank showing they are complete and properly seated.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as IBC-style plastic water storage tanks in metal cages, so it can be priced at a worst-case assumption. However, grade, capacity, leak status, and valve/cage condition are not verifiably confirmed from the photos, so the price should reflect the highest uncertainty until the requested proof is provided.
